test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b009610a2c99e67f03c0f4f5cd3cfd30c06f41c4bc9a3a3548f7823c2a1876ce.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series → 1st Box and 3rd Box

The elements at the corners shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c30cadd0e53f320d95daf09a52cd93807f3680e82cec6f881b89f4bcc8c0b0c.png] 

2) Second box series → 2nd Box and 4th Box

The 1st row elements and first element of 3rd row shift clockwise subsequently.

The center element is replaced by the new element.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e692bf0e813a012fa51860835c85fc03d61edd725c48efda3d839ec1542513cc.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6c14c60b7443d400e963454a35a68f9881310812abe41b485a9550704f97bfa.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
